svg.text: Make the new closet passage (printed page 20)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
HOLD: existing-wall role, services, support and opening detail
The existing kitchen-side pantry door stays. The new door-sized walk-through is cut through the back
01. Identify the complete EX1 wall section on both faces and above the ceiling: gravity/lateral role,
posts/straps, header conditions, wires, pipes, insulation and any rated or bracing function.
02. A qualified reviewer sets the exact opening width/location, exposed finish limits, retained members,
any temporary support, header/jamb and sill/threshold detail. Do not use the closet's 37-in inside width
The kitchen-side door, jamb and casing are retained. Neither new W1 nor W2 frame contains this doorway.
EX1 framing, patch boards and trim are not included in the new-wall board/stud takeoff.
